_comment: Snapshot of current holdings, not a transaction ledger. Each entry stores TODAY's shares and AC/share (average cost per share) exactly as shown on your Yahoo Finance Holdings tab - including dividend-reinvested shares, since AC/share there is already the weighted average across every purchase and every reinvestment. Whenever Yahoo's numbers change (a DRIP event, a manual buy/sell), update 'shares' and 'ac_share' here to match. No other fields need to change when that happens.

holdings.note: UNCONFIRMED - the Yahoo screenshot this was seeded from had no last price/market value for this row. Verify this is a real, separate ASX-listed holding (distinct from LOC.NZ above) before trusting alerts on it; remove this entry if it's stale.
